answer: The strongest lever is simple: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because sable only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, anchor is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any glacier approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
